wml_root_path.description: The base directory for the website source files. Used to define ROOTREL/ROOTABS.

wml_base_url.description: The base URL for the generated website. Used to define ROOTABS.

wml_include_paths.description: List of directories added to the include path (-I/--include).

wml_definitions.description: List of global variable definitions in 'NAME=VALUE' format (-D/--define).

wml_optimization_level.description: Optimization level for HTML output (-O/--optimize). Range 0-9.

wml_passes.description: Comma-separated list of pass numbers to execute (-p/--pass).

wml_safe_mode.description: Enable safe mode to disable Perl fork speedups (-s/--safe).

wml_includefile.description: Path to a file to pre-load as an include (-i/--includefile).

wml_prolog_filter.description: Path to a program to run as a prolog filter on input (-P/--prolog).

wml_epilog_filter.description: Path to a program to run as an epilog filter on output (-E/--epilog).

wml_set_time.description: Set output file modification times to input + 1 second (-t/--settime).
